Contract Generator.contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let newOb: LoanRequest in
		newOb.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentLoanRequest = newOb and
		newOb.RequestID = requestid and
		newOb.Name = name and
		newOb.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		newOb.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		newOb.Income = income and
		newOb.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		newOb.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		newOb.ZipCode = zipcode and
		newOb.Email = email and
		newOb.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		newOb.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		newOb.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		newOb.SecurityNumber = securitynumber
}
